name: Tsuchigumo
source:
A towering giant of a man who is over two meters tall. The cultists treat him as a living god.

He is a descendent of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuchigumo]the Tsuchigumo[/url] - the people who in ancient times refused to submit themselves to the rule of the Imperial Court, and were driven off their lands into the depths of Japan's mountains. It is said that they survived to become [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanka_(ethnic_group)]the Sanka[/url], and now live impoverished and marginalised lives.

Calling himself the King of a forsaken people, Tsuchigumo stands in the way of Len and her comrades.

[Translated from [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime/#a_chara9]the official description.[/url]]
